description: This file defines the RootCanvas SwiftUI View for the iOS app, managing app state, UI presentation, and navigation logic, including onboarding, settings, chat, and quick setup sheets. It interacts with environment objects, manages UI flows based on app state, and encodes some payload data for the home canvas view.

classes.name: RootCanvas
classes.description: Main SwiftUI View managing the app's root interface, including onboarding, settings, chat, and quick setup sheets, as well as app state and gateway status handling.

classes.name: HomeCanvasPayload
classes.description: A Codable struct representing the payload data used for the home canvas display, including gateway status and agent information.

classes.name: HomeCanvasAgentCard
classes.description: A Codable struct representing an agent card's data for the home canvas.

classes.name: CanvasContent
classes.description: A SwiftUI View representing the main content area of the root view, including toolbar, overlays, and user interaction components.

classes.name: CameraFlashOverlay
classes.description: A simple overlay view that flashes white to simulate a camera flash using nonce value to trigger animation.

methods.name: startupPresentationRoute
methods.description: Determines which startup route to present (none, onboarding, settings) based on app state.

methods.name: shouldPresentQuickSetup
methods.description: Determines if the quick setup sheet should be presented based on various app states.

methods.name: updateIdleTimer
methods.description: Enables or disables the idle timer based on scene activity and preventSleep setting.

methods.name: updateCanvasDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates the debug status display with the current gateway status and server info.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Encodes payload data and updates the app model's home canvas state for UI rendering.

methods.name: makeHomeCanvasPayload
methods.description: Constructs the payload to display on the home canvas, including gateway and agent statuses.

methods.name: resolveActiveAgentID
methods.description: Returns the ID of the currently active agent, falling back to default.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAgentID
methods.description: Returns the default agent ID based on app model data.

methods.name: homeCanvasAgents
methods.description: Builds a list of agent cards for the home canvas, marking active and default agents.

methods.name: homeCanvasName
methods.description: Returns a normalized display name for an agent.

methods.name: homeCanvasBadge
methods.description: Generates a badge (initials or emoji) for an agent for display.

methods.name: normalized
methods.description: Trims whitespace and returns a non-empty string or nil.

methods.name: evaluateOnboardingPresentation
methods.description: Decides whether to present onboarding or settings based on app state.

methods.name: hasExistingGatewayConfig
methods.description: Checks if there is existing configuration for the gateway.

methods.name: maybeAutoOpenSettings
methods.description: Auto-opens settings if conditions are met.

methods.name: maybeShowQuickSetup
methods.description: Displays quick setup sheet if criteria are satisfied.
